item.title: Bet You Didn’t Know This About Halloween
item.itunes:author: CNN Podcasts
item.content:encoded:
A social experiment involving hundreds of phone calls is challenging assumptions about how divided the US is. He’s explored all seven continents by wheelchair, overcoming the odds and hoping to inspire millions to do the same. Hear just how successful a first-of-its-kind cancer vaccine was. How running became a lifeline for a New York City marathoner experiencing homelessness. Plus, some of Halloween’s most beloved traditions have surprisingly strange origins.  

Host/Producer: Krista Bo Polanco 

Producer: Eryn Mathewson 

Showrunner: Felicia Patinkin 

Editorial Support: Allison Lau, Rob Picheta, Sandee LaMotte, Meg Tirrell

item.title: Alaska’s Senate Showdown Intensifies
item.description: President Donald Trump has revived two previously canceled campaign rallies ahead of next week’s midterm elections. The battle over the validity of Alaska’s unusual Senate race is heating up again. For the second time, a federal appeals court has blocked the Justice Department’s attempt to halt ballot counting in California. An ICE officer has been charged with aggravated assault after a chaotic arrest in Houston. Plus, the only person known to have survived an attempted execution by lethal injection is speaking out for the first time. Learn more about your ad choices. Visit podcastchoices.com/adchoices

item.title: What a Midterms Road Trip Taught Us about Rust Belt Voters
item.itunes:title: What a Midterms Road Trip Taught Us about Rust Belt Voters
item.itunes:author: CNN Podcasts
item.content:encoded:
Every election season we hear a lot about the battlegrounds of Pennsylvania, Ohio and Michigan. But what makes these places special? And how are voters there feeling about the midterms? One CNN team has put in many, many hours this week seeing as much as they can – and livestreaming it for everyone.

--- 

Guest: Omar Jimenez, CNN Correspondent 

Host: David Rind 

Producer: Paola Ortiz 

Showrunner: Felicia Patinkin

item.title: The Election Conspiracies Spreading Among MAGA Faithful
item.itunes:title: The Election Conspiracies Spreading Among MAGA Faithful
item.itunes:author: CNN Podcasts
item.content:encoded:
When President Donald Trump promised to accept the midterm election results this week, he added an important caveat: “if they are honest elections.” While there is no evidence anything dishonest is going on, critics say it’s just the latest example of Trump sowing doubt in an election that could be bad for Republicans. We explore what conspiracy theories are taking hold in Trump’s base and separate fact from fiction around Trump’s claim that the polls are “rigged.” 

--- 

Guest: Donie O'Sullivan, CNN Senior Correspondent 

Host: David Rind 

Producer: Paola Ortiz 

Showrunner: Felicia Patinkin
